how: We read the website of every Houston wedding DJ listed on Lazo (96 listings, 62 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: booking agencies, national DJ chains with a Houston page, one-stop entertainment chains, AV production and party rental companies. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
If the ceremony is outdoors in Houston heat, what sound and power do you bring, and what is the plan if it rains?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Enloe Entertainment LLC
picks.blurb: Enloe Entertainment is a family-owned company in business since 2010, registered in Montgomery County, that calls itself a complete event partner from planning to the last dance. Pricing varies by how far the venue is, and wedding packages are listed for Houston and College Station.

picks.name: The Danny B DJ Company, Houston Tx.
picks.blurb: DJ Danny B has over 20 years of wedding experience and leads with clear introductions, a well-groomed appearance and the right music. The company adds dance lighting, a photobooth and a dry-ice effect for the first dance, serving Houston and surrounding areas.

picks.name: Incredevents
picks.blurb: IncredEvents in Katy charges from the moment the music begins, with no fee for setup or takedown, and a $100 retainer to hold the date. The owner started on two turntables at 16, and packages are printed, from $2,000 at our read, with photo booth and lighting as rentals.

picks.name: Mehfilix
picks.blurb: Faisal Ishaque founded Mehfilix as Houston's South Asian wedding DJ and MC service after years as a pop-rock singer with live wedding bands; one of his songs charted on Pakistan's PTV and India's ZTV. The site walks through the flow of the night, not just the music.

picks.name: Imperial Entertainment
picks.blurb: Imperial Entertainment describes its DJs as energy creators, bilingual MCs and cultural connectors rooted in Houston, with weddings as the main specialty. A three-step process of consultation, plan and party, with AV production, lighting and a photobooth in-house.

picks.name: Partyland Entertainment - Wedding DJs
picks.blurb: Ernest, founder and lead DJ of Partyland Entertainment, has spent more than a decade behind the booth at Houston weddings and quinceañeras and says music is only half the job. Bilingual DJ and MC service, photo booths, uplighting and cold sparks for the grand entrance.

picks.name: Houston Luxury Events
picks.blurb: Houston Luxury Events fields a roster of DJs, MCs, event hosts, special-effects technicians, photobooth attendants and wedding coordinators, built around DJ Ceez. One contract can cover the music, the booth and the lighting.

picks.name: Xceptional DJ's + Photobooths
picks.blurb: Forrest Crump launched Xceptional DJ's in 1999 as a one-man operation and trained with the city's established DJs before moving into weddings. DJ and photo booth packages, with reviews and video testimonials from real clients gathered on one page.

picks.name: Dhol Beat International
picks.blurb: DJ Impact created Dhol Beat International and has been in the business over 15 years as an Indian wedding DJ in Houston, with Dallas and Austin covered too. The pitch is traditional services with a modern touch and the logistics of a full production.

picks.name: DJ Ferbidden - Ferbidden Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Ferbidden brings the urban influence of Philadelphia and Baltimore to Houston, spinning R&B, hip-hop, house and Top 40 with seamless transitions from song to song. More than 15 years as a mobile DJ, serving Houston and the Hill Country.

picks.name: Elegante Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Francisco of Elegante Entertainment is a bilingual Spanish and English DJ and MC with over 25 years of experience and, in his words, a low-key wedding planner who likes to take control of the event. Houston, Conroe, The Woodlands, Katy and Sugar Land.

picks.name: The DJ Event Group
picks.blurb: The DJ Event Group is a full-service wedding DJ company based in Missouri City serving all of Houston, pitching organized, reliable DJs and flawless execution. Photobooth and lighting come from the same team.
